department: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (College of Engineering)

deadline.value: Priority consideration for the Fall 2027 PhD closes December 10, 2026; funding consideration is automatic.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need to secure a faculty advisor before applying; PhD students are matched with one after admission.
supervisor.quote: You do not need to secure a faculty advisor before applying to the program.

funding.value: The School offers a limited number of teaching and research assistantships, prioritised for PhD applicants; admission without funding is possible.
funding.quote: offers a limited number of graduate teaching assistantships (GTA) and graduate research assistantships (GRA)

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a baccalaureate degree or equivalent; completion of an M.S. is typical but not strictly required before entry.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have or will complete a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university before the start of their entry term.

notes: The 'our program does not provide application fee waivers' line on this page sits in the MEng section, so it is not used for the PhD. School-level funding and faculty statements (EECS) are the same for the AI PhD record.
